body:
I read bout ambien online and decided to give it a go. My friend gave me five pills for free, and I took three and gave two away. Me and my friends were going on a trip to get weed, I let my friend drive my blazer because of the high to come.
First thing I noticed was being completely relaxed, physically and emotionally. As I  watched cars going by at nightime, the light waves twisted. At one point a truck turned and looked right at me. Time seemed to stand still. And I had the coolest vision, when I looked at white fingerprint marks on my window I seen little smiling people dancing in the outline where the fingerprints use to be.
The hazy feeling lasted for about two hours. I recommend ambien for anybody that likes quality visions. It also can give a euphoria/hypnotized feeling. I bet it'll go good with Robo or Salvia, can't wait to get that free sample in the mail.
